programmes.d: Police officer Lin Kai receives an assignment to infiltrate a drug cartel called Twin Eagles. His operation starts to spiral out of control when he slowly but unwillingly becomes an addict while trying to gain the leader's trust.
An evil government mercenary (Burt Reynolds) coerces an ex-agent (Matt Battaglia) into helping his team find a valuable top-secret decoder.
The warden of a 2022 prison sends an ex-Marine (Ray Liotta) to a jungle island where inmates are left to die.
During the Vietnam War, a French army convoy is ambushed.
A former commando searching for his son in Vietnam is tasked with uncovering the people responsible for deadly attacks on American and British personnel throughout Southeast Asia.
A Dutch pilot risks everything to keep his plane in the air.
While searching for a prospective wife, a deceptive widower (Ryo Ishibashi) meets a mysterious and deadly woman (Eihi Shiina).
An American nurse (Linda Blair) discovers an Australian doctor's (Tony Bonner) deep-sleep therapy can be fatal, and often is.
